content.title: About
content.content: Roasted potato NFS is a selection of high‑quality tubers sliced and fried to a golden crisp. The product retains the natural flavor of potato, offers a crunchy texture and a light salty note.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Potato is the fourth most produced agricultural commodity worldwide.
Roasted potatoes are a common side dish in fast‑food restaurants.
NFS (Not From Scratch) indicates a ready‑to‑eat product manufactured by standardized processes.
There are over 4,000 potato varieties, but high‑starch types are preferred for frying.
Frying at 180‑190 °C creates a golden crust while keeping the interior tender.

items.title: Rich in potassium
items.content: Potato provides potassium, which supports normal blood pressure and muscle function.

items.title: Vitamin C
items.content: Some vitamin C remains after frying, contributing to immune support.

items.title: Complex carbohydrates
items.content: Potato contains slowly digestible carbs that give sustained satiety.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: The skin of roasted potatoes retains fiber that aids digestion.

items.title: Beta‑carotene
items.content: Certain varieties contain beta‑carotene, a precursor of vitamin A important for vision.

items.title: High fat content
items.content: Frying increases the calorie density; portion control is advised for weight‑watchers.

items.title: Acrylamide formation
items.content: High‑temperature frying can produce acrylamide, a potentially harmful compound; avoid over‑cooking.

items.title: Potato allergy
items.content: Rarely, some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to potato.

items.title: Salt
items.content: Excessive salt in the ready‑made product may be unsuitable for people with hypertension.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Roasted potatoes can be enjoyed as a snack, added to salads, used in dishes like fries, or served as a side to meat and fish. Sprinkle with fresh herbs, spices, or cheese before serving.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a sealed package in a cool, dry place. For longer storage, refrigerate to prevent oil oxidation. Discard if the product develops an off‑odor or discoloration.
